full_text:
ADDENDUM <No. 2794, June 28, 2018>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on March 1, 2019.
Article 2 (Transitional Measures concerning Scope of Adjudicative Affairs) Cases to be tried by the Incheon Outlying Division of the Seoul High Court under amended Article 2 that are pending before the Seoul High Court as of February 28, 2019 shall continue to be tried by the Seoul High Court.
